summary: Part 3 (12:05-15:10) of the Buybox (Sellers) training covers the Gamification section of the Buybox Training workbook. The trainer shows how to accept a small or big price drop on the AE Tool (UAE and South Africa) and the SA Tool (Saudi Arabia). Each tool has a small-drop table (titled under 20 AED) and a big-drop table (titled over 20 AED). The seller ticks the 'Accept change?' checkbox on chosen SKUs, then clicks the matching 'Accept small price drop' or 'Accept big price drop' label on the sheet. The trainer says the ticked SKUs will then disappear from the sheet and the buybox prices update automatically, but no frame shows that result. The trainer then recaps the buybox training (catalog organization, neutral prices, buybox prices, lowest condition, how to win, minimum prices). All 26 listed frames were opened and checked against the narration. Several speech-recognition errors were corrected from the screen. Some items are unclear and are listed in unclear.
